prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” personal injury lawyer for every Chicago car-accident case — the right attorney depends on your injuries, the complexity of the claim, whether fault is disputed, whether you need a firm with trial resources, your budget/fee preferences, and how you like to communicate. I can, however, help you find a top lawyer for your situation.  

Quick guidance
- Look for firms with substantial automobile-accident experience, trial experience (if needed), strong client reviews, and a record of significant settlements/verdicts.  
- Ask about contingency fees (typical 33–40%), who pays case costs up front, how they handle medical liens, estimated timeline, and whether they’ll try the case or settle.  
- Verify credentials: Illinois Attorney Registration & Disciplinary Commission (ARDC), Martindale‑Hubbell, Super Lawyers, AVVO, Google reviews, and local court records for verdicts.

Well-known Chicago personal-injury firms (frequently recommended; worth vetting)
- Clifford Law Offices — national reputation for catastrophic-injury and wrongful‑death auto cases; significant verdicts/settlements.  
- Corboy & Demetrio — long history handling serious injury and wrongful-death claims in Chicago.  
- Levin & Perconti — experienced with auto collisions and catastrophic injuries; sizable recoveries.  
- Power Rogers (Power Rogers & Smith) — established Chicago PI practice handling car-accident claims.  
- Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard — handles serious injury and wrongful-death matters (confirm practice areas).

What to bring/prepare for a consult
- Crash report, photos/videos, medical records/bills, insurance info (yours and other party’s), contact info for witnesses, timeline of events.  
- Ask for references of recent similar cases and whether they’ll handle your case personally or pass it to another attorney/associate.

If you want, I can:
- Produce a short, vetted list of attorneys near you (I’ll need your ZIP code).  
- Draft a list of questions to ask during an initial consult.  
- Help you evaluate fee agreements or compare two lawyers you’re choosing between.

Do you want a tailored shortlist? If so, tell me your ZIP code, date of the crash, injury severity, and any other preferences (trial experience, language, budget).
